items.desc:
Pub Address: The Fellow, 24 York Way, London, N1 9AA.

Date: Sunday, 15/11/2026 1pm

The idea is to just meet and have a chat really.

I have submitted a request to book a table. Hopefully they approve but if not we can just find an un-booked table.

I am posting the meetup prior to receiving their approval, so that those of you who live outside London can (hopefully) bag a cheaper train ticket by booking 2 weeks in advance.

I've created a London Lobsters Whatsapp group too, where we can communicate on the day to share the table number/updates.

Please do join it.
